shortDescription.default: Document upload and AI assistant web part for SharePoint and Microsoft Teams.

longDescription.default: This solution contains a single SharePoint Framework client-side web part (`DocumentAiWebPart`) that can be used in SharePoint pages (including full-page apps) and as a Microsoft Teams personal app/tab. The web part provides an AI-powered document upload assistant that reads document contents, suggests metadata and upload locations, and surfaces guidance text configured via the web part properties. The package also includes a custom property pane password input control used to securely configure the Azure OpenAI API key.

features.title: BiznextApp Document Upload AI Agent
features.description: Activates the BiznextApp Document Upload AI Agent client-side web part and supporting custom property pane control.
